# MediaConvert

> MediaConvert is a free, 100% private online audio converter and video-to-audio extractor that processes all media locally in the web browser using WebAssembly FFmpeg. Zero file uploads, no registration, no tracking.

## Core Capabilities
- **Audio Conversion**: Convert between MP3, WAV, M4A, FLAC, AAC, OGG, OPUS, AIFF, and WMA.
- **Video to Audio Extraction**: Demux and extract crystal-clear audio tracks from MP4, MOV, MKV, WEBM, AVI, WMV, FLV, 3GP, and TS video containers.
- **Audio Utilities**: Precision Audio Cutter, Audio Merger, Audio Compressor, Bitrate Changer, Speed Changer (0.5x - 2.0x), and Volume Adjuster (-20 dB to +20 dB).
- **100% Client-Side Privacy**: All decoding and encoding executes inside the user's browser sandbox via WebAssembly (Wasm). 0 bytes of audio/video content are uploaded to remote servers.
- **Batch Processing**: Convert multiple tracks simultaneously and download all results in a single structured ZIP archive.
- **Advanced Controls**: Customizable bitrate (64 kbps to 320 kbps), sample rate (22050 Hz to 48000 Hz), channels (mono/stereo), and start/end time trimming.

## Free Pricing & Terms
- **Price**: $0.00 / Free forever
- **Subscription**: None
- **Registration**: Not required (no login, no email, no credit card)
- **Limits**: Unlimited conversions, unlimited file queue
- **Full Pricing Details**: https://mediaconvert.org/pricing.md

## Main Web Tools
- [Audio Converter](https://mediaconvert.org/audio-converter): Universal audio format conversion interface.
- [MP4 to MP3](https://mediaconvert.org/mp4-to-mp3): Extract high-quality MP3 audio from MP4 video clips.
- [WAV to MP3](https://mediaconvert.org/wav-to-mp3): Compress studio 16/24-bit PCM WAV recordings into portable MP3s.
- [M4A to MP3](https://mediaconvert.org/m4a-to-mp3): Convert Apple Voice Memos and iTunes audio files to universal MP3.
- [FLAC to MP3](https://mediaconvert.org/flac-to-mp3): Convert audiophile lossless FLAC albums to 320 kbps MP3.
- [MOV to MP3](https://mediaconvert.org/mov-to-mp3): Extract audio from Apple QuickTime MOV recordings.
- [MP3 to WAV](https://mediaconvert.org/mp3-to-wav): Decompress MP3 into uncompressed 16-bit PCM WAV for audio editing and DAWs.
- [OGG to MP3](https://mediaconvert.org/ogg-to-mp3): Convert OGG Vorbis game sound effects and voice clips to MP3.
- [OPUS to MP3](https://mediaconvert.org/opus-to-mp3): Convert WhatsApp voice notes, Discord voice recordings, and Telegram audio to MP3.
- [AAC to MP3](https://mediaconvert.org/aac-to-mp3): Convert raw AAC and ADTS streams to MP3.
- [Audio Cutter](https://mediaconvert.org/audio-cutter): Trim and extract audio segments with waveform sliders and playback preview.
- [Audio Merger](https://mediaconvert.org/audio-merger): Combine multiple audio tracks into a single concatenated file.
- [Audio Compressor](https://mediaconvert.org/audio-compressor): Reduce audio file sizes by 40% to 80% while retaining clarity.
- [Audio Bitrate Changer](https://mediaconvert.org/audio-bitrate-changer): Re-encode audio to 64k, 128k, 192k, 256k, or 320k.
- [Audio Speed Changer](https://mediaconvert.org/audio-speed-changer): Speed up or slow down audio with automatic pitch correction.
- [Audio Volume Adjuster](https://mediaconvert.org/audio-volume-adjuster): Boost quiet audio recordings or attenuate loud tracks.
- [Format Guide](https://mediaconvert.org/format-guide): Technical comparison and guide for all audio codecs and containers.

## Technology & Compatibility
- **Core Engine**: WebAssembly-compiled FFmpeg 0.12+ (Single-threaded UMD core for maximum cross-browser worker stability).
- **Supported Codecs**: libmp3lame (MP3), pcm_s16le (WAV), aac (M4A/AAC), flac (FLAC), libvorbis (OGG), libopus (OPUS).
- **Browser Requirements**: Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Edge, Opera, or mobile browsers (iOS Safari, Android Chrome) with WebAssembly enabled.
